parsed.explanation: The write-up's only route to finiteness is the "finite blocker" fact: a pairwise-intersecting family of finite sets has finitely many minimal finite transversals. That claim is false (ledger L6.2: F_k = {x_1,...,x_k, y_k} is pairwise intersecting yet has infinitely many minimal finite transversals), so its "proof" must fail, and the objection locates the gap correctly: contraction/pruning is applied to a modified branch containing c, while the actual branch's nodes never contain c, so no node of the original infinite branch is shown to be contracted; "dispensable" and "contract" are also undefined. No number-theoretic large-prime erasure argument appears anywhere else, so L6.2 is unestablished and no local edit repairs a false lemma.
